name: Amano Tamako
source: She's a celestial police officer on an undercover mission to investigate the strange situation of Ayame living as a ghost in the real world. Despite looking like a child, her true age remains a mystery. She has the power to manipulate the memories of those around her, but for some unknown reason, it doesn't work on the protagonist. She’s a hidden character who only appears if you see the bad ending at least once.
